list.name: path
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT path FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics ORDER BY path

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1m'), COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::double precision AS value FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 100)::double precision AS availability FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring})

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 0)::double precision AS err_rate FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring})
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms),0)::double precision AS avg_ms FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring})
SELECT COUNT(*)::double precision AS req_count FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${path:sqlstring} = '$__all' OR path = ${path:sqlstring})

SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS requests, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric, 1) AS p95_ms, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS error_pct FROM ra_t_api_request_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY path ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 15
